sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.subject: Our position
move.body: Thank you for your quote. I will be honest with you: our team is under real pressure on this part.

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We understand your team is under pressure, and we have always stood by our partners in challenging times. To support you, we are prepared to lower our price to €52.30 per unit, provided we maintain the 12-month contract and 30-day payment terms. Please understand that this concession is significant for us, as we must also ensure our own operational stability. 

For our current Angebot, we can offer a price of €52.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. 

Alongside this proposal, we can also offer an alternative at our standard terms with a price of €52.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026.

Please note that our offer remains valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.subject: Our position
move.body: If I come back without your real limit, my team loses the part to a competitor and I lose standing here. Help me help you keep the volume: what price can you truly not go below?

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot. We value our long-standing relationship and want to support you, but we cannot negotiate against unverified claims of competition. Please provide concrete data regarding these competing offers so we can understand the situation better. 

Until then, our offer of €52.00 remains firm for the 24-month contract with 60-day payment terms. Our current Angebot stands at a price of €52.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.subject: Our position
move.body: You would be saving my quarter. One number — your floor — and I will defend your volume personally.

move.text:
Guten Tag,

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. We appreciate your personal commitment to our partnership, but as a matter of principle, we do not disclose internal limits or calculations. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. 

Our offer of €52.00 is already our firm position for a 24-month contract with 60-day payment terms. The offer is a price of €52.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. This offer is valid for 7 days.

If you are able to commit to a binding higher volume, please provide the exact figures so we can review what might be possible. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
